rows.definition: Env-var name carrying the transcript-UUID-derived relaunch cache-affinity route onto a resumed claude --resume child, so the warm provider cache route survives the OS relaunch (#4140/#5189).
rows.distinction: The relaunch-carry env carrier for the resume watchdog's per-transcript cache route, distinct from the Anthropic managed-cache TTL upgrade (c4681-cachettlupgrade) and from RelaunchCacheAffinityEnv which is the Go const naming this same variable.
